memos.headline: A journal publication of Phase 3 results already announced; FDA decision Nov 30 is the event; VRTX flat
reasoning: Source: Vertex's release (Benzinga 17:43 UTC): 'Phase 3 RAINIER Results Supporting Potential Of Povetacicept In IgA Nephropathy Published In The New England Journal Of Medicine; Vertex's Povetacicept Shows 49.8% Greater Proteinuria Reduction vs. Placebo In Phase 3 IgAN Trial; FDA Decision Expected November 30'.
What changed: the peer-reviewed paper of a trial whose interim result was announced earlier and is the basis of a filing already under FDA review. The decision date (Nov 30) was known.
Read-across: 49.8% on povetacicept vs 43.1% on Ionis/Roche's sefaxersen an hour earlier in the same disease; Vertex's figure is the stronger of the two, but both were public in some form already.
Price: VRTX -0.15% since the item, on 43 IEX shares; -1.9% on the day.
objections: Publication of previously announced Phase 3 results; no reaction.
